notes.title: Updated on April 2
notes.content:
1. Add a Zhuang Shiying tidbits to unlock the final chapter Zhuang Shiying ending
2. Add subtitles for sweet moments
3. Sweet Moments and tidbits, add back button to play page
4. Chapter 4 GUI Sihan came to the company to talk about cooperation "Go or stay" the first video, before the English subtitles did not show, now modified
5. Sweet Moment & Tidbits add fast forward function, when playing the video, the pause icon will only be displayed when the left mouse button click, the space bar (before pressing any key will appear), convenient for players to screenshot
6. Modify ESC button logic: Press ESC to pop up the pause menu. Press ESC for the second time to close the pause menu and continue the game
7. Chat page picture click to open a large image
